section_summary.extract_value: This section describes procedures for a single study conducted between June and December 2015: Standard Chinese translations of the BAS-2, PFRS, and SWLS were prepared via back-translation, and participants (required to be from mainland China and fluent in Standard Chinese) completed anonymous paper-and-pencil questionnaires after providing written consent. The study was advertised on campus locations and questionnaires were completed in private cubicles; no sample size, demographic breakdowns, BMI assessment, or correlation statistics are reported here. There is no mention of 'Study 1' or multiple studies in this section.
